English.name: KJV
English.description: The 1611 English translation commissioned by King James I, prized for its literary influence and traditional English phrasing.

English.name: NASB
English.description: A modern, formal-equivalence English translation known for close word-for-word accuracy to the Hebrew and Greek texts.

English.name: DRC
English.description: An English translation of the Latin Vulgate produced by English Catholic scholars, most commonly used in its 18th-century Challoner revision.

English.name: CPDV
English.description: A modern public-domain English translation of the Latin Vulgate, prepared for accuracy and readability in a Catholic context.

French.name: FreSegond1910

French.name: FreVulgGlaire
French.description: Traduction française de la Vulgate latine par Mgr Jean-Baptiste Glaire, largement utilisée dans les milieux catholiques francophones.
